name: Bookster Discounts and Fees
author: Bookster

sections.description:
This Bookster Discounts and Fees Addon integrates custom pricing into your Bookster checkout experience. You can create multiple rules to discount or markup your service prices.

Need other features? Explore our All Access plan here ↗

Features

Merchants can create pricing rules to charge extra amounts or give discounts on checkout for customers.

Custom Discounts

  • Time-Based Discounts: Set discounts for specific times (e.g., “Happy Hour” or “Off-Peak Deals.”).
  • Date-Based Discounts: Offer discounts on specific dates, such as holidays or special events. (e.g., Singles’ Day on 11/11).
  • Service-Based Discounts: Apply discounts based on services booked or other customized criteria.
  • Customer-Based Discounts: Offer discounts to specific customers, such as existing customers, VIP members, or loyalty program participants in multiple treatment sessions.

Dynamic Fees

  • Peak Hour Fees: Charge extra during high-demand periods (e.g., weekends for beauty salons).
  • After-Hours Fees: Implement fees for services rendered outside of regular business hours (e.g., appointments after 5 PM at dental clinic).
  • Rush Fees: Charge additional fees for urgent or expedited services (e.g., express photo editing services).
sections.installation:
Requirements Check

Before installing, verify you have:

  • ✅ Bookster free plugin version 2.2.0 or higher (check Plugins → Installed Plugins)
  • ✅ WordPress 5.0 or higher

Step 1: Install the Addon

Quick Install:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
2. Search for “Bookster Discounts and Fees”
3. Click Install Now next to Bookster Discounts and Fees plugin
4. Click Activate when installation completes

Upload ZIP:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
2. Click Upload Plugin
3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
4. Click Activate Plugin
sections.faq:
What is the Bookster Discounts and Fees plugin?

It’s an extension for the Bookster plugin that lets you create flexible pricing rules directly within your booking checkout. Instead of fixed service prices, you can offer discounts or apply extra fees based on conditions like date, time, service, agent, location, and customer.

Do I need anything extra to use this add-on?

Yes. The Bookster core plugin must be installed and active first. Once you install and activate the Discounts and Fees Addon, the Discounts section will appear inside your Bookster Settings dashboard immediately.

Where do I manage discounts in Bookster?

Go to your Bookster dashboard, then navigate to Settings → Discounts. From there you can create new discounts, edit existing ones, and filter your list by status: Active, Scheduled, or Expired.

What discount types are supported?

You can create both percentage-based discounts (e.g. 15% off) and fixed amount discounts or fees (e.g. $10 off or +$5 surcharge). The value type is selected per discount when you create or edit it.

Can I schedule discounts in advance?

Yes. Each discount has a Date Range field where you set a start and end date, plus a start time and end time. Discounts set for a future date will appear as Scheduled in your list and activate automatically when the time comes.

Can I repeat a discount on specific days of the week?

Yes. The Repeat Weekdays option lets you restrict a discount to certain days — useful for recurring promotions like a Monday Happy Hours discount, or a weekend surcharge.

Can customers apply more than one coupon per booking?

By default, only one coupon can be applied per booking. If you want to allow stacking, enable the Multiple Coupons toggle in the Usage Restrictions tab for that discount. When enabled, customers will see all eligible coupons at checkout and can apply more than one.

How do customers apply a coupon at checkout?

Eligible coupons are shown automatically on the checkout screen under “Pick a coupon.” Customers can select one (or more, if multiple coupons are allowed) and the discount is reflected in the booking summary before they confirm.

Can I temporarily disable a discount without deleting it?

Yes. Each discount has an Active toggle in the Usage Restrictions tab. Turning it off makes the discount unavailable for appointment bookings while keeping all its settings intact.

What does the coupon code generator do?

When creating a discount, you can either type a custom coupon code or click “Random” to generate one automatically.

Can I limit which services a discount applies to?

Yes. Under Usage Restrictions, you can select one or more specific services. Services are grouped by category in the dropdown, making it easy to target the right ones. For example, applying a discount only to “Cat Treatment” or “Puppy First Groom.”

Can I restrict a discount to a specific agent, location, or customer?

Yes. Usage Restrictions lets you target any combination of agents, locations, and customers. You can leave any of these set to “All” to apply the discount without that restriction.

Can I limit how many times a coupon can be used?

Yes. You can set a Total Coupons Code limit (or leave it Unlimited) and a separate Usage Limit Per Customer to control how many times a single customer can apply the same coupon.

Got other questions or issues?

No problem, feel free to contact us.
